display_name: DJI Power AURO 2000 ELITE（大疆户外电源）

texture.glowmask: LCD, AC button, power LED, charge bar (AutoGlowingGeoLayer)

real_reference.outputs: AC 2000 W (CN ref photo: 3 sockets), built-in retractable USB-C cable 140 W, USB-C 65 W x2, USB-A 12 W x2, SDC x2
real_reference.inputs: AC 1440 W (0-80% ~85 min), SDC solar 600 W x2

model_size_px.front_layout: front-panel features were measured on reference/1_hero.png in u = -X (viewer right) coordinates

suggested.note: 0.125 -> 0.89 x 0.44 x 0.48 blocks (about 1.95x real size, similar to the drones in this pack)

bones.name: body
bones.desc: shell (rounded corners, stepped lid, handle ears over louvred cavities, side holes), dark front band, AC tray + 3 CN outlets + AC button, middle panel with the cable recess/slot, SDC cover, 2x USB-A (orange) + 2x USB-C, LCD, 2 SDC covers, lid power button, rear ports/label, feet

bones.name: plug_yaw
bones.desc: plug translation + yaw (keeps the plug euler away from gimbal lock)

bones.name: plug
bones.desc: 140 W USB-C plug (metal tip, MAX 140W label, grip ribs); rest = lying in the front slot, tip -> -X

bones.name: cab_01 .. cab_48
bones.desc: flat ribbon segments 3 px long (2.4 x 0.55 px). Cubes are modelled as a straight vertical chain; each bone has a REST ROTATION that folds the chain into the stowed reel inside the body, so Blockbench shows the stowed cable and every animation value is a small bend (no gimbal).

animations.name: animation.auro2000elite.cable_stowed
animations.desc: state: cable in the slot (all zero = rest)

animations.name: animation.auro2000elite.cable_out
animations.desc: state: cable pulled out, plug lying on the ground in front

animations.name: animation.auro2000elite.cable_plugged
animations.desc: state: plug inserted into the device spot (DEVICE px (-14,0,-85.5))

animations.name: animation.auro2000elite.cable_extract
animations.desc: pop out of the slot, pulled forward and laid on the ground; cable unreels from the slot

animations.name: animation.auro2000elite.cable_retract
animations.desc: dragged back along the ground, lifted and clicked into the slot; cable reels in

animations.name: animation.auro2000elite.cable_plug
animations.desc: picked up, aligned and pushed into the device port

animations.name: animation.auro2000elite.cable_unplug
animations.desc: pulled out of the device and laid down

animations.name: animation.auro2000elite.cable_unplug_retract
animations.desc: unplug + retract in one go (shift+right click while charging)

animation_sampling: 40 keys/s generated by a cable path solver (Bezier + gravity sag, clamped to the ground and kept in front of the panel; internal reel); verified: FK error at keys < 0.004 px, between keys < 0.55 px
generator: DJI/tools/gen_auro2000.py <out>  (cable solver: tools/auro_cable.py; previews: tools/preview_auro.py; GIFs: tools/make_auro_gifs.py)
